verdict.rationale: Windows documents its own developer toolchains (C# with .NET 8+, C++ Win32/WinRT, Rust via windows-rs) and first-party AI tooling (Windows AI Foundry toolkit, Windows AI APIs, local AI tools). The evidence does not name any IDE, and nothing shows that the latest third-party toolchains or AI/ML software treat Windows as a primary supported platform. Missing for 10: documented IDE support, evidence of primary/first-class support from mainstream third-party toolchains and AI/ML frameworks, independent hands-on corroboration of developer experience.

support.subject: As a developer, I can use the latest IDEs, toolchains, and AI/ML software on a primary supported platform

citations.quote: C# with .NET 8 or later, C++ (Win32 and C++/WinRT), Rust (via windows-rs crate).
